setlist.title: Beat it on Down the Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell in a Bucket** (2 reviews): Attendee recalls the band tearing through the opening Bucket and Bertha as if it were their last time; Reviewer says the Bucket opener could reach out-there territory quickly; its layered guitar washes resemble R.E.M [16][22]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): The crowd chanting for Phil can be heard at the end of Big Railroad Blues [18]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Jerry is nearly inaudible at the start of Let it Grow, sounding as if going through the motions [15]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): The Sugar Magnolia into Sunshine Daydream sandwich is called the part of the show you need [12]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Second set energy improves, with Foolish Heart named the highlight before drums [15]
- **Space** (1 review): Space has a distinct Spanish jam flavor around the four-minute mark [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **Around n' Around**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd91-09-12.sbd.hinko.28871.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1991-09-12.149847.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [4]
- **gd1991-09-12.149784.sbd.millerflac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [5]
- **gd1991-09-12.139651.schoeps-cmc4-mk4.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 165 min [6]. Said about its sound: This Schoeps audience recording sounds a little livelier than the GEMS Schoeps version [23]
- **gd1991-09-12.fob.brennecke-young.GEMS.97386.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended on his birthday, his only birthday show in about 35 with the Dead [12]
- Phil Zone fans on the floor chanted for Phil, and he then sang Tom Thumb's Blues [17]
- The run was three 3-day stands at Madison Square Garden with a day off between each [19]
- Attendee saw this and the next two shows, but missed the preceding show with Branford [20]
- Reviewer says 9/10 beat the first two shows of the run and led to three high-energy shows, 9/12 to 9/14 [12]
- Reviewer calls the first set one of the weakest of the Hornsby era, with Jerry barely present [15]
- The run falls short of the MSG shows a year earlier, such as 9/20/90 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-09-12.sbd.hinko.28871.sbeok.shnf**: source: Clean up of SHNid=516 [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to CDR to SHN; Darryl Hinko cleaned up the earlier SHNid 516 transfer [1]
- **gd1991-09-12.149847.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 2, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [4]
- **gd1991-09-12.149784.sbd.millerflac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 2, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [5]
- **gd1991-09-12.139651.schoeps-cmc4-mk4.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Audience recording > Schoeps cmc4 mk4 (ortf) > Oade modified Panasonic SV-255 > dat (48k) - Recorded by Rick Gastwirt from 1st row OTS;… [6]
- **gd1991-09-12.fob.brennecke-young.GEMS.97386.flac16**: taped by James Young and Clay Brennecke; transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: B&K 4011 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro Recording Location: FOB - Hand Held, Upfront [7]. Also: Released by GEMS in May 2008 from the master DATs as part of the Young and Brennecke FOB Vault project [7]
